utility.notes: Corona is confirmed to be genuinely split between two separate electric providers, with no majority established this session. The City's own Expedited Permits page states applicants must obtain 'a separate application process and approval from the electric utility authority for your address' — naming both 'Southern California Edison' and the 'Corona Utilities Department' as the possible provider depending on address. Southern California Edison's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet also lists Corona. The City of Corona Department of Water and Power (DWP) is confirmed to be a real, separate municipal electric utility (not a fringe/pocket service) with a stated peak electric demand of 25.8 MW, its own Electric Service and Direct Access programs, and a dedicated solar contact. Neither provider's percentage of Corona's total service territory could be confirmed this session, so utility is left null rather than guessed.

generation_supplier.notes: Cannot be determined without first resolving which of the two utilities (SCE vs. Corona DWP) serves a given address; Corona is not a Western Community Energy member.

interconnection_url.notes: Interconnection process depends on which of the two electric providers (SCE or Corona DWP) serves the applicant's address; not recorded to avoid implying a single utility-wide process.

value.name: Separate application and approval from the applicable electric utility authority (SCE or Corona DWP, depending on address)

value.program_or_pathway: Expedited plan check (Central Inverter PV, Microinverter/ACM PV, Rooftop Solar Domestic Water Heating, Rooftop Solar Pool Water Heating)
other_conditions: Plan check processing does not begin until plan check fees are confirmed paid
Corona Utilities prohibits 'Tesla Backup Switch' or similar devices attached directly to the electric service meter; such devices must be installed downstream in a separate enclosure

permit_fees.notes: The page states plan check fees apply but directs applicants to a separate fee schedule not fetched this session.
